question: Should signed marketplace feed refresh merge only after rollback prevention and signed-profile URL override semantics are repaired?
rationale: This PR defines a new trust boundary for hosted marketplace feeds; the remaining issues are not cosmetic because they determine whether signed feeds can be replayed or bypassed.

options.title: Require trust-boundary repairs first
options.body: Block merge until signed snapshots persist sequence/freshness, reject rollback before write/return, and keep signed profile verification when URL overrides are present or reject that flag combination.

options.title: Accept the current trust risk
options.body: A maintainer could explicitly accept signed-feed rollback and override bypass risk for this stack slice, but that weakens the security model the PR is adding.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep this PR open but paused behind the predecessor RFC/source-profile decisions if maintainers want to settle the trust contract outside this branch first.

recommendation.title: Require trust-boundary repairs first
recommendation.body: Block merge until signed snapshots persist sequence/freshness, reject rollback before write/return, and keep signed profile verification when URL overrides are present or reject that flag combination.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the current assignee/reviewer on this PR and already separated mechanical CI repair from the substantive trust-model findings.
